digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool steering / convergence boundary
propositions: After a tool call, pydantic-ai's .filtered() cutoff omits toolConfig from requests while history contains toolUse blocks, causing Bedrock/Anthropic ValidationException 400 on the convergence boundary
The existing tool_step_limit mechanism converts runs that exceed the limit into provider errors (LLMUnavailableError) rather than graceful landing
Replace the .filtered() empty-cutoff mechanism with a WrapperToolset steering wrapper that stops tool execution and returns synthetic results instead of hiding tool definitions

Tool definitions must remain advertised throughout the entire run to satisfy provider protocol constraints; steering achieves graceful convergence by returning advisory text rather than removing tools
The steering wrapper preserves existing UsageLimits budget exhaustion as the terminal backstop for models that ignore steering and keep calling tools
